decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed additional floor space will not have any adverse affect upon the servicing arrangements or appearance of the building to the Conservation Area. The building will be accessible to disabled persons this is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and ENV.B.1.8. (Access and facilities for people with disabilities) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Informative
The plans approved under this application for variation of condition 2 should also be read in conjunction with the remaining conditions imposed upon permission 01130/D/P10, which still apply to the permitted development.
description: Variation of planning permission 01130/D/P10 to allow for additional floorspace and alterations to elevations of existing building.
